mapper.select: SELECT resource.id, resource.url, resource.request_method, resource.is_anonymous, role.role_label FROM tb_resource resource LEFT JOIN tb_role_resource role_resource ON resource.id = role_resource.resource_id LEFT JOIN tb_role role ON role_resource.role_id = role.id WHERE resource.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND resource.url IS NOT NULL AND resource.request_method IS NOT NULL ORDER BY resource.id
SELECT role.role_label FROM tb_role role JOIN tb_user_role user_role ON role.id = user_role.role_id WHERE user_role.user_id = #{userInfoId} AND role.is_disable = 0 ORDER BY role.id
